top_choice_rationale: P002 honours a quantitative prediction (flat bands at a magic angle, Bistritzer-MacDonald 2011) followed by the experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene, a hard many-body problem turned into a tunable experiment and reproduced by many laboratories. With the citation restricted to flat-band prediction and the experimental discovery, and silent on pairing mechanism, it rests on secure results. Its weaknesses are real: the field is about eight years old and the experimental credit is wider than Jarillo-Herrero (Dean, Young, Yacoby, Efetov, Yazdani). P001 is mature and cleanly attributed, so it is a close second, but it is an instrument-level advance. A prize in either case is preferred to no award.
